build_tool_grammar: build an EBNF grammar string for valid tool calls from a world graph with objects and rooms
build_response_grammar: build a response grammar combining tool calls, agent actions, and termination rules for constrained LLM generation
prepare_prompt: prepare an LLM prompt with RAG examples, tool descriptions, agent descriptions, and world state from a world graph
get_next_action: get the next low-level actions for agents by calling the LLM, parsing responses, and processing high-level actions
replan: replan high-level actions by generating an LLM response with optional constrained grammar generation from the current prompt
